description: Verify a Magist grounding-proof token: the "groundingProof" field on a regulation or control record from the REST API (GET /api/v1/regulations/{id} or /api/v1/controls/{id}) when the server has signing enabled. MCP tool responses do not carry these tokens. Proves the citation was genuinely served by Magist's server for that exact atom at that exact corpus version; it does NOT verify legal correctness or that any obligation applies to a product. Returns valid:false with a reason when the token is missing, malformed, unsigned, or fails signature verification; this is expected when the record never carried a token (signing is an opt-in server setting).

token.description: The groundingProof object exactly as received on a prior response (carries alg, mgstId, corpusVersion, quoteHash, nonce, and the signature fields). Pass it back unmodified.

name: verify_ai_answer
title: Verify a Magist citation
